fields.label: Asked on (doctype)
fields.description: The form this question is part of. It is shown on that form and its answer is kept with the record - no field is added to the doctype.

fields.label: Question No
fields.description: The number the question carries on the questionnaire, e.g. 12 or 4.2.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Switch off to stop asking it, without deleting.

fields.label: Group as
fields.description: Individual question: shown on its own. Section: shown with the other questions of the same section. Tab: shown in its own tab on the form, next to the form's other tabs.

fields.label: Section
fields.description: Questions with the same section name are shown together under it, e.g. Rent details. In a tab, this is optional.

fields.label: Tab
fields.description: Becomes a tab on the form, e.g. Health Survey. Questions with the same tab name share it.

fields.label: Answer Type
fields.options:
Text
Number
Date
Yes / No
Select
Multi-select

fields.label: Options
fields.description: One option per line. Used for Select and Multi-select.

fields.label: Show only if (optional)
fields.description: Show this question only when another question has a given answer, e.g. show "Which scheme?" only when "Do you receive a government scheme?" = Yes.

fields.label: Another question
fields.description: Show this question only when that question has the answer below. e.g. Do you receive a government scheme?

fields.label: Has the answer
fields.description: The exact answer that makes this question appear, e.g. Yes (or Rented, Widowed).

fields.label: Display depends on (optional)
fields.description: Show this question only while a field of a doctype has a value, e.g. Household Profile > House Ownership = Rented.

fields.label: Doctype
fields.description: The form that holds the deciding field, e.g. Household Profile.

fields.label: Field
fields.description: The field whose value decides, e.g. House Ownership (use the field name: house_ownership).

fields.label: Condition
fields.description: How to compare. e.g. "=" Rented shows it for rented houses; "!=" Owned shows it for all but owned; "is set" shows it once any value is filled; "is not set" shows it while the field is empty.

fields.label: Value
fields.description: The value to compare with, e.g. Rented. Not needed for "is set" / "is not set".

fields.label: Section display depends on (optional)
fields.description: Applies to the whole section above. Saving it here updates every other question in the same section. e.g. show the whole "Rent details" section only while Household Profile > House Ownership = Rented.

fields.label: Doctype
fields.description: The form that holds the deciding field, e.g. Household Profile.

fields.label: Field
fields.description: The field whose value decides for the whole section, e.g. House Ownership (house_ownership).

fields.label: Condition
fields.description: How to compare. e.g. "=" Rented shows the section for rented houses; "is set" shows it once the field has any value.

fields.label: Value
fields.description: The value to compare with, e.g. Rented. Not needed for "is set" / "is not set".
